Under it, smaller warm yellow text reads “あなたには”, then a huge central result word reading ネコ, followed by smaller text “の気配が漂っています”. Decorate the title with exactly 6 prominent small motifs: 2 pink flowers, 2 small stars, 1 butterfly, and 1 ribbon.

Layout: Split composition with text cards on the left and hero visuals on the right. The left column contains exactly 5 translucent rounded white cards with soft pink borders and tiny icon decorations. The right side contains exactly 2 main visual elements: one circular anime portrait frame above and one cat-shaped donut on a plate below.

Left column text cards: Card 1 is titled “理由は” and contains a short explanation saying the person has a mysterious refined mood, coolness but also sweetness, and a cat-like presence. Card 2 is titled “ネコの特徴” and lists exactly 5 bullet points: free-spirited and goes at their own pace; cautious but affectionate; aesthetically sensitive and elegant; sweet only with trusted people; observant and clever. Card 3 is titled “相性が良い動物” and contains exactly 2 compatibility animals with simple line icons: “オオカミ” with a note about respecting independence and forming strong bonds, and “ウサギ” with a note about a gentle soothing personality. Card 4 is titled “運勢” and lists exactly 5 fortune lines: overall luck, love luck, work luck, lucky item, and lucky color. Card 5 is titled “ネコドーナツについて” and explains that the donut is coated in cocoa and white chocolate, has shiny purple glaze, fluffy ears and tail, and is a special donut packed with cat charm.

Right circular portrait: Create an ornate round frame filled with sparkles, pearls, flowers, crescent moon charms, and a small ribbon. Inside is a mysterious anime-style catlike girl with silvery lavender hair, dark gothic clothing, purple gemstone accessories, luminous highlights, and a dreamy night-sky glow. Cover the center of her face with a plain opaque gray square censor block, matching the generated composition.

Cat donut hero: In the lower right foreground, show one large cat-shaped donut on a delicate white plate with gold trim. The donut has a cream-and-lavender icing design, purple glaze dripping around the bottom, glitter sugar, exactly 2 upright cat ears, exactly 1 curled purple tail on the right, exactly 1 purple bow on the upper right ear, exactly 2 large glossy purple eyes, exactly 3 whisker lines on each cheek, a tiny smiling mouth, small blush cheeks, and scattered edible pearls. Add a small gold fork at the lower right of the plate.

Visual style: Ultra-cute kawaii dessert illustration, glossy 3D-anime hybrid, high detail, soft glow, pastel pink background, magical sparkles, clean readable infographic typography, rounded Japanese fonts, white text boxes, delicate decorative borders, feminine and sweet. Use pastel pink, lavender, cream, and gold.

Constraints: Keep all Japanese text legible, do not add extra cards or extra main characters, maintain exactly 5 left-column cards, exactly 2 compatibility animals, exactly 1 cat donut, and a polished social-media diagnosis result poster look.\

Panel 2 is the upper-right lore panel titled with Japanese text meaning “What kind of abnormal head is it?” and includes a small cropped portrait of the duck-camera-headed figure at the top right plus a small device diagram at the bottom. Goal: Create an ornate anime idol character collage featuring Akari, a long-haired gothic star-themed performer shown in multiple poses like a collectible photo card layout.

Canvas: Vertical portrait image, roughly 3:4 aspect ratio, dark navy and warm gold palette, high-detail anime illustration with glossy lighting. Use a grand cathedral or concert-hall interior in the background, with tall arched windows, columns, warm backlight, floating confetti, tiny stars, and magical sparkle effects.

Layout: Build a symmetrical scrapbook/contact-sheet composition with exactly 7 character images total: 1 large central full-body panel and 6 smaller surrounding numbered panels. The 6 small panels are labeled in gold as 01 top-left, 02 top-right, 03 middle-left, 04 middle-right, 05 bottom-left, and 06 bottom-right. Each panel has a thin ornate gold frame, rounded corners, and small film-strip details along some edges. The central panel is the tallest, framed with decorative gold filigree at the top and a small plaque beneath it containing 5 icons: star, star, crown, star, star. At the bottom center between the lower panels, add a decorative gold eight-point star emblem, laurel branches, and a small curved film ribbon.

Subject details: The same anime girl appears in every panel. She has very long black hair with cool blue highlights, straight glossy hair flowing past the waist, hair clips shaped like stars and crosses, pale skin, and a soft idol-girl presence. Her face should be visible and beautiful in the generated artwork, not obscured. Outfit: white puff-sleeve blouse with ruffled neckline, black ribbon bow at the chest, black choker with frills, high-waisted navy-black flared skirt with white ruffle hem and starry galaxy gradient, wide black belt with silver ring buckle, dangling star-chain accessories at the hip, black fingerless gloves, bracelets, thigh straps or garter details, and subtle silver jewelry. Overall theme: gothic-lolita idol, celestial night-sky motifs, elegant yet energetic.

Panel contents: Show exactly these 7 poses: central full-body pose facing forward, making a peace sign near her face with one hand; panel 01 upper-body pose holding a microphone near her waist; panel 02 upper-body pose with one hand near her collar or choker; panel 03 half-body pose holding a microphone downward; panel 04 upper-body pose with one gloved hand raised near her face; panel 05 side/back three-quarter pose looking over her shoulder with hair flowing dramatically; panel 06 upper-body cheerful idol pose with both hands raised in small finger-heart or pointing gestures and a large microphone floating or angled at the lower right.

Visual style: Premium Japanese anime key visual, crisp linework, luminous eyes, polished skin shading, layered hair highlights, intricate clothing folds, deep navy shadows, gold trim, cinematic rim lighting, soft bokeh, sparkles, confetti, and a luxurious idol trading-card aesthetic. Use high resolution and dense decorative detail without clutter.

Text content: Only include the small gold panel numbers 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06 and the tiny symbolic plaque icons under the central panel; avoid extra readable text.

Constraints: Keep exactly 7 character depictions and exactly 6 numbered small panels. Maintain one consistent character and outfit across all panels. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, or modern UI elements.\

title: 夏日天台柠檬苏打

prompt_en:
Subject:
Rooftop lemon soda

People & Expressions:
Three clearly adult women in their 20s. All have natural skin textures, clear Japanese-style natural makeup, and brown to black hair. The woman in the bottom left has a high ponytail and laughs brightly while looking up at a giant glass. The woman in the top right has a short bob and sits on the rim of the glass with a gentle smile. The woman in the bottom right has shoulder-length black hair and sits on a cloth, looking up happily.

Clothing & Poses:
The bottom-left woman wears a white sleeveless top, coral red shorts, and is barefoot. She rests one foot on a transparent ice block and reaches her right hand toward the giant glass. The top-right woman wears a yellow open-knit sleeveless top, light blue denim shorts, and white strap sandals. She sits naturally on the top-right rim of the giant glass, her seat and thighs firmly in contact with the edge. She lightly holds a thick red and white striped straw with one hand and rests the other hand on the rim. Her legs hang naturally outward, one slightly forward and one back for stability. The bottom-right woman wears a white sheer shirt, pale orange inner layer, and pale yellow shorts, sitting relaxed with one hand behind her.

Background & Lighting:
A Japanese rooftop terrace. White railings, blurred city buildings in the distance, potted plants, a small white table, and drink accessories. A giant transparent glass of lemon soda sits in the center. Golden carbonated liquid, plenty of bubbles, large ice cubes, sliced lemons, topped with vanilla ice cream and a red cherry. Strong summer sunlight from the top right creates warm highlights on cheeks, hair, shoulders, glass rim, water drops, ice, lemons, and the wet floor. Thin puddles on the floor reflect the sparkling light.

Composition & Camera:
9:16 vertical aspect ratio. The giant lemon soda glass is centered, occupying about 65-70% of the frame. The three women are arranged in a triangle. Camera is at a slightly low, eye-level angle. Natural compression of approximately 50mm. Subjects and glass are sharp, background is softly blurred with shallow depth of field.

Texture & Style:
Bright, warm Japanese-style realistic photography. Refreshing and open, like a summer advertisement. High-definition depiction of glass thickness, transparency, refraction, condensation, bubbles, ice edges, lemon pulp, and floor reflections. Overlayed with colorful hand-drawn doodles and Japanese notes. Yellow cloud bubble: 'Happiness lemon soda found on the rooftop ♡', pink: 'Best~!!', purple: 'Fizzy fizzy~', light blue: 'So cold!', yellow: 'Big summer memories ♡', bottom blue: 'Splashing sparkling~!!'. Light and fun summer album style.\

prompt_en:
A cinematic documentary style photograph of a young girl skateboarding at an outdoor skatepark while wearing a traditional pink and white sari-style outfit with embroidered floral borders and a translucent pink veil over her head. She is captured from a very low angle perspective, making the skateboard and her movement feel bold, powerful, and larger than life. The camera is placed close to the edge of the ramp, emphasizing the curve of the concrete surface, the wheels of the skateboard, and the balance of her body.
The environment is an open air skatepark during late afternoon, with soft natural sunlight, trees in the background, a pale sky, and a few people standing casually in the distance. The background should remain slightly out of focus so the main subject feels strong and cinematic. The concrete ramp has realistic scratches, faded paint marks, and worn textures, giving the scene an authentic street sport atmosphere.

The subject’s expression should feel focused, brave, and slightly tense, as if she is concentrating on balancing and controlling the board. Her pose is dynamic: one foot planted firmly on the skateboard, the other guiding the movement, one arm stretched outward for balance. The flowing fabric of her traditional outfit should create beautiful motion and contrast against the hard concrete ramp and skateboard.

Color palette should feel natural and warm: vibrant pink and red fabric, soft white skirt tones, pale blue-gray concrete, muted green trees, and a bright open sky. The color gradient should move from darker shadow tones near the skateboard and ramp to bright airy light in the sky, creating a realistic backlit effect. The pink veil should glow slightly under the sunlight, adding softness and emotion to the scene.

The final image should feel empowering, poetic, and cinematic. A powerful contrast between tradition and modern street culture, showing courage, identity, movement, and youthful freedom.
